entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2602406721431348096: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 20.0568 +/- 0.0189 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 49.86 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 168.785, -145.602 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.6694 +/- 0.030496 solar radii from Dressing et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-116 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..207D/abstract). Mass 0.694512 +/- 0.069451 solar masses from Dressing et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-116 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..207D/abstract). Temperature 4348.35 +/- 86.1 K from Dressing et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-116 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,348.35 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffdbb5. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,348.35 K and log g 4.63 (u1 0.751, u2 0.039): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
